note: Verified macOS control surface per app. `confidence: verified` means it was executed on this machine and its effect read back. Anything not listed here was either refuted or never tested -- see `impossible`.

readback.script: tell application "Spotify" to return player state as text

capabilities.intent: play a track, album, playlist or artist by URI
capabilities.notes: Accepts album/playlist/artist URIs too, despite the dictionary saying track. An invalid URI exits 0, silently stops playback and leaves current track unreadable -- validate the shape first.
Resume only. Never the handler for 'play <name>'.

capabilities.intent: jump to a position in the track

exec.script: tell application "Spotify" to set player position to <float>

capabilities.notes: Float is mandatory; an integer raises -1700.

exec.script: tell application "Spotify" to set sound volume to <0-100>

capabilities.intent: turn a spoken song name into a URI
capabilities.notes: Client Credentials is enough: no user login, no Premium. Untested here -- no keys on this machine.

capabilities.intent: close Spotify's window, keep the music

impossible: Liking/saving the current song: `starred` is read-only, there is no menu item anywhere, and no default shortcut. Needs PUT /v1/me/tracks with user OAuth.
Repeat-one versus repeat-all: AppleScript exposes `repeating` as a boolean only.
Any UI automation: the whole window is one opaque AXGroup. AXManualAccessibility is rejected (-25205).

readback.script: tell application "Arc" to tell front window to return (URL of active tab) & linefeed & (title of active tab) & linefeed & (title of active space)

capabilities.intent: what page and space the user is on
every tab in the window, with its kind

exec.script: URL of every tab of front window / location of every tab of front window

capabilities.notes: `location` is topApp | pinned | unpinned. Favourites (topApp) are NOT in `tabs of <space>` -- enumerating a space alone cannot see the homepage tab. Per-tab loops cost 1419ms; the list form costs 226ms.

exec.script: tell front window to select tab <i>

capabilities.notes: Window-indexed selection can switch the active space, because window tabs span all spaces. Favourites never do.

capabilities.intent: open a page in the current space

exec.script: tell front window to make new tab with properties {URL:"<url>"}

capabilities.notes: Never `open -a Arc <url>`: that makes a Little Arc window invisible to AppleScript. Never bare `open <url>` either -- the default http handler here is Velja, a URL router.

capabilities.intent: send the current tab somewhere else

exec.script: tell front window to focus (first space whose title is "<name>")

capabilities.notes: `active space` is read-only (-10006).

capabilities.intent: play/pause/seek the video in the tab
capabilities.notes: Pick the element: prefer one already playing, then readyState>0 and duration>1, then largest. A /shorts page had three video elements where the first was a decoy.

exec.script: tell front window to close active tab

impossible: Pinning or unpinning a tab: `set location` always fails -10000 despite being declared read-write.
Split view: absent from the dictionary.
Opening a tab in another space without switching to it.
Creating or renaming a space; bookmarks, history, downloads, profiles.

Reaching page globals from injected JS: `execute javascript` runs in an isolated world, so window.yt and movie_player are undefined and a <script> tag is blocked by CSP. The DOM and real controls do work.
Running JS against a loading tab without a timeout: it blocks to the 60s Apple Event timeout (-1712).

capabilities.notes: Strip the dashes: the canonical UUID form silently no-ops. Never emit an https:// Notion link -- it resolves to Velja here.

capabilities.intent: open one view of a database
press a named sidebar row, back, forward, inbox
capabilities.notes: Works while Notion is backgrounded. Native menu-bar AXPress does not.

impossible: Any scripting dictionary: sdef returns -192. AppleScript for Notion means System Events UI scripting, ~150ms a read versus 0.04ms through a cached AX handle.
Opening Settings or switching workspace by URL.
Synthetic keystrokes to a backgrounded Notion: verified failing.

setup: AXUIElementSetAttributeValue(app, 'AXManualAccessibility', True), then poll for AXDescription == 'User Settings'. Re-arm on launch and after Cmd+R.

capabilities.intent: which channel and server are open

capabilities.notes: Voice channels are AXButton, text channels are AXLink. Only the SELECTED server is in the tree.

capabilities.intent: switch to a text channel by name
capabilities.notes: Takes effect while Discord is backgrounded -- no focus steal.

capabilities.intent: connect to a voice channel by name
capabilities.notes: The press mechanism is verified on channel buttons; joining a live call was not tested, so the result is always read back rather than assumed.
State reads correctly; the toggle itself was not pressed, to avoid unmuting a live mic.
Its ABSENCE is the reliable 'not connected' signal.
Silent no-op for a server the account is not in. No guild ids are available from AX.
Drops an active call -- guarded behind an explicit 'anyway'.

impossible: Joining voice by URL: no discord:// route connects to voice. Nor do mute, deafen, screen share or disconnect have URLs.
Screen share without a human: the control opens Discord's source picker and macOS stacks its own picker on top.

Enumerating servers or channel ids: AX gives names only, the local config directory is EPERM under TCC, and this machine's Discord exposes no menu-bar extra to read. The complete route is Discord's local RPC server (127.0.0.1:6463), which needs a self-registered dev app.
Using the account token against Discord's HTTP API: self-botting, account-terminating.

exec.call: MRMediaRemoteSendCommand(<0 play|1 pause|2 toggle|4 next|5 previous>, NULL)

capabilities.notes: Replaces synthesising NX_KEYTYPE_PLAY, which a focused app can swallow.
The owner is the LAST app to register, not necessarily the audible one -- always cross-check liveness.

exec.target: AXFocusedWindow -> AXTitle on a cached app element

impossible: Reading Now Playing metadata from MediaRemote: the info dictionary is entitlement-gated and comes back empty. Ask the owning app instead.
Knowing which app a global media key would reach.
